exposure: haemoglobin after the first ante-natal care visit
Haemoglobin after the first ante-natal care visit
cohort: Newborns at an intermediate hospital in Northern Namibia
finding: Gravidity, parity, haemoglobin after the first ante-natal care visit, ante-partum haemorrhage (APH), membrane status, duration of labour, type of delivery, and caesarean section type and indication were all found to be associated with an immediate low Apgar score.
mod_finding: Type of delivery and caesarean section type and indication were associated with immediate low Apgar score.
